name: A-2-Z Granite Fabrication
audience: Homeowners, remodel GCs and kitchen dealers in south San Jose
description: Stone fabrication and install shop on Monterey Highway: countertops, fireplaces, shower surrounds and exterior stone, templating through install.
services: Removal and disposal of old stone
insight: Fabricators win on template accuracy and lead time - both publishable metrics that no local competitor states.
usps: Edge profiles and seams shown honestly
Templating to install in days, not weeks (confirm)
differentiators: Publishes lead time, seam policy and profile samples; competitors quote in person only

reputation.note: No review surface captured: win on shop photography, lead times and profiles.

afford: Kitchen stone packages run $4K-$20K with whole-home multipliers
A fabrication shop with polishing and CNC capability is real capital
Install-led businesses close on turnaround, which a site can promise and measure
risk: Stone sourcing claims must be verifiable
Review base must be built; expect a slow start on reputation
